title: Paddle flow switch deflection
line: Steady oil flow at 1 m/s bends the spring-steel paddle of a flow switch in a 2-inch tee; fluid and paddle are solved together against a 1 mm trip travel.
description: A paddle flow switch in a 2-inch schedule 40 tee: the oil in the tee and a 0.5 x 24 x 82 mm EN 1.4310 spring-steel paddle clamped in the switch boss, each its own body in the RunMat MCAD part. The fluid-structure study solves laminar ISO VG 46 oil at 40 C and 1 m/s (Re 1140) with the paddle's bending, and reports the tip deflection against the 1 mm trip travel and the stress at the paddle's root.
thumbnailAlt: Spring-steel paddle of a flow switch hanging across the bore of a pipe tee, modeled in RunMat
